en.title: Depth of Breath
en.premise: As a 10,000-meter runner trapped in a severe slump, "I" head to a mountainous training camp dotted with abandoned villages erased from the maps. Amidst lonely runs, relying only on aching joints and the numerical heartbeat, I confront my own limits. On the night of a lunar eclipse, on a course swallowed by darkness, I rediscover my lost confidence and the fundamental meaning of running.

zh.title: 呼吸的深度
zh.premise: 作为一名陷入严重低谷的万米长跑选手，“我”前往一座座从地图上消失的废村点缀的山区进行集训。在孤独的奔跑中，“我”仅凭身体的酸痛与心跳的数字，直面着自身的极限。在月食之夜、被黑暗吞没的赛道上，“我”重新找回了失去的自信，以及奔跑的根源意义。
